title: Initial v8 audit attempt aborts during result serialization
failure: KeyError: total_change_from_checkpoint while reading optional code-churn metadata for a fallback-compensation artifact
interpretation: The frozen candidate reached the audit process but the script aborted while assembling non-gating report metadata. No metrics were printed or written and no candidate choice or hyperparameter was changed. A disclosed technical retry uses the identical checkpoint, artifact, suite, gates, bootstrap settings and seed after a one-line metadata fallback fix.
